content_sections.heading: About MAIDS
content_sections.text: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences is an autonomous institution under the Govt. of NCT of Delhi, located on B.S. Zafar Marg, New Delhi. This post is for its project "Dental Technology Innovation Hub- Centre for Research, Innovation and Development of Dental Technologies", which falls under the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Govt. of India.

content_sections.heading: MAIDS ICMR Project Research Scientist-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Not more than 35 years as on the last date of application. Experience is also reckoned with respect to this date. Bachelor of Design / B. Tech in any discipline from a recognised university or equivalent. 1 year of experience in Medical/Dental Product development. This is preferred, not mandatory. For the discipline-specific eligibility of this post, see the official notification.

Closing date of receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Competent Authority scrutinises the applications and documents against the eligibility criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview. Further evaluation is notified through the institutional website. A list of selected and waitlisted candidates is displayed on the institutional website. The decision of the Competent Authority on selection will be final, and no representations will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is purely on contract basis, and the incumbent has no right to regular appointment. The contract is for one year. It may be extended based on performance and extension granted by ICMR. The post is with the project at MAIDS, New Delhi. No TA/DA or other allowances will be paid for the interview or for joining the post. The Competent Authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, withdraw the process in full or in part, and reject any or all applications without assigning reasons or giving notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAIDS ICMR Project Research Scientist-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form on pages 3 to 5 of the official notification. Write the post applied for clearly on top of the form. Fill in your personal details, qualifications and work experience, and affix a recent passport size photograph. Tick the certificates attached at serial number 9 of the form, then date and sign the declaration. Deliver the form and documents by hand or send them by post to: Principal Investigator, Dental Technology Innovation Hub, Room No. 309, 3rd Floor, Phase II Building, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, MAMC Campus, BS Zafar Marg, New Delhi-110002. Passport size photograph: the instructions ask for one, while the checklist in the form lists two along with the application form Self-attested age proof Self-attested educational, technical, academic or professional certificates Self-attested experience certificate, if any Applications lacking complete information or copies of relevant documents are liable to be rejected without any communication. The institute will not be responsible for any postal delay on the part of any delivery agency.

faq.question: Q1. Can a B. Tech graduate from any branch apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The essential qualification is a Bachelor of Design or B. Tech in any discipline from a recognised university, or equivalent.

faq.question: Q2. Is experience compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: No. The 1 year of experience in Medical/Dental Product development is listed as desirable, not essential.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply if I turn 36 after the closing date?
faq.answer: Your age is reckoned on the last date of closure of applications, so what matters is that you are not more than 35 years old on that date.

faq.question: Q4. Can I submit the application by hand?
faq.answer: Yes. You can hand it in at Room No. 309, 3rd Floor, Phase II Building, or send it by post to the same address.

faq.question: Q5. Does a posted application count from the date it was sent?
faq.answer: No. The complete application must reach the institute by 12:00 noon on the closing date, and the institute takes no responsibility for postal delays.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The contract is for one year, and any extension depends on performance and on ICMR granting it.

faq.question: Q7. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: Further evaluation is notified through the institutional website, so check there after the scrutiny of applications.

faq.question: Q8. Who can I contact with a query?
faq.answer: Contact Mr. Deepak Kumar at 9953312951 between 02:00 and 04:00 pm, Monday to Friday. Email communications will not be entertained.
